enrollmentConsent.consentScrollHint: Scroll to the end to continue
enrollmentConsent.consentPurposeBody: You are enrolling your own face as a reusable character so FizzDragon can generate videos containing your likeness, when you ask it to.
enrollmentConsent.consentDataBody: The face images (and video/audio references) you upload for this character, and a liveness verification session — a short camera-based facial check that confirms a live person is enrolling.
enrollmentConsent.consentTransferBody: Your face data is transferred to and processed by BytePlus (ModelArk) in the ap-southeast-1 (Singapore) region, which may be outside your home jurisdiction, to power likeness generation.
enrollmentConsent.consentRetentionBody: For as long as this character stays active. If you revoke, provider-side assets are deleted and our copies of your face data are permanently deleted within 30 days. A consent ledger — timestamps, versions, and hashes, never face images — is retained as legal evidence.
enrollmentConsent.consentScopeBody: Only you. This character lives in your default workspace and can be used only by your own account in your own projects. It is never shared with other users, teams, or workspaces.
enrollmentConsent.consentWithdrawBody: You can revoke at any time by deleting this character. Revoking deletes the provider-side face assets, cancels running generations that use this likeness, and starts the 30-day purge of your face data.
enrollmentConsent.consentOutputsBody: Revoking does not automatically delete videos you generated earlier. You can delete them from your projects yourself, and you can report any misuse of your likeness for takedown.
